info.title: LiquiLens Undertow MCP
info.description: Read-only market liquidity research from LiquiLens Undertow: indicative BTC exit sizes, depth episodes, venue concentration and a sealed record of calls that keeps its misses. Every reading carries its clock and coverage, and PARTIAL means missing history, never calm. Estimates are not executable quotes or investment advice.

post.description: Sends Model Context Protocol messages to the hosted LiquiLens Undertow server over Streamable HTTP. The agent runtime manages the session, so makers do not call this operation directly.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Media types the MCP server may return.
